FINE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: FINE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.
   D. Practise Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.

5. Best practice when working on D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween: (1 mark)
   A. Practise D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.
   C. Disrupt classmates during D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.
   D. Refuse all feedback on D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.

6. Best practice when working on Graphic Design: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Graphic Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Graphic Design.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Graphic Design.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Graphic Design.

7. Best practice when working on Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting.
   C. Practise Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting.

8. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.
   C. Practise Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2.5 Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indige: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2.5 Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indige.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2.5 Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indige with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2.5 Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indige.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2.5 Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indige.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

12. Best practice when working on Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Mosaic.
   B. Practise Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Mosaic.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing . and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
